topic: SimdVF reduction and bf16 load, resolved by probe

results.bf16_load: vld(x_ub, dist="UNPK_B16") + vcvt(v,"float32",part=0) over 64 bf16 elements equals torch exactly
results.reduce_to_scalar: 64 f32: vld -> vmul -> 6x vcadd(pset(32)) -> vsts lane0 equals torch sum(x*x) exactly (85344.0)
results.pset_parameter: pset takes ELEMENT WIDTH in bits (32 for f32), not a lane count; pset(16)/pset(8) are invalid elwidth and fail to resolve

implications: the two hardest unknowns of the SimdVF path are now resolved: bf16 load/cast and full cross-lane reduction
a per-row sum of squares can be built as: accumulate squares per lane over D/64 chunks with vmula, then a 6-step vcadd chain to a scalar
remaining unknowns: bf16 vsts write-back dist, scalar broadcast of rstd, reduction instruction cost, and final performance
not_proven: no RMSNorm kernel yet; no timing; no parity claim
